# Sakuga VFX

> Ordinary UI controls that react like anime: squash and overshoot on springs, and drawn effects (smoke, impact bursts, slashes, splashes, rumbling) with manga sound-effect lettering, on one canvas over the page. Each is one plain script that registers a custom element: no dependencies, no build step, no other files to fetch. MIT licensed.

Live gallery: https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app
Source: https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx

## Drop-in components (24 total)

Each is one plain script that registers a custom element. Load it with a script tag, not as a module. Do not rewrite or split the file. Each file carries a copy of the shared core; the first one loaded sets window.SakugaFX and the rest reuse it, so any mix shares one canvas and one loop.

- [Button](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/button/button.js): `<sakuga-button>`: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame with clouds and ドン!. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/button/README.md)
- [Toggle](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/toggle/toggle.js): `<sakuga-toggle>`: Switch whose flip is 43 painted frames with splash. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/toggle/README.md)
- [Slider](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/slider/slider.js): `<sakuga-slider>`: Range slider whose thumb stretches and lags with cumulus. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/slider/README.md)
- [Checkbox](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/checkbox/checkbox.js): `<sakuga-checkbox>`: Slashes with crystals, tick draws itself, ズザッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/checkbox/README.md)
- [Radio](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/radio/radio.js): `<sakuga-radio>`: Dot springs in with wedges, puffs and ポン. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/radio/README.md)
- [Input](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/input/input.js): `<sakuga-input>`: Text field that kicks up dust from caret on every key. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/input/README.md)
- [Tabs](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/tabs/tabs.js): `<sakuga-tabs>`: Raised tab slides, stretching, and lands with a puff. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/tabs/README.md)
- [Progress](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/progress/progress.js): `<sakuga-progress>`: Storm cloud rides leading edge with ゴゴゴゴ and finishing ドン!. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/progress/README.md)
- [Rating](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/rating/rating.js): `<sakuga-rating>`: Stars pop with ポン; five gets a burst. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/rating/README.md)
- [Toast](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/toast/toast.js): `<sakuga-toast>`: Notification streaks in with smear and ズザッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/toast/README.md)
- [Tooltip](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/tooltip/tooltip.js): `<sakuga-tooltip>`: Springs out like a speech bubble with カチッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/tooltip/README.md)
- [Select](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/select/select.js): `<sakuga-select>`: Dropdown menu that springs open and slices on pick with カチッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/select/README.md)
- [Accordion](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/accordion/accordion.js): `<sakuga-accordion>`: Collapsible panels with spring height transition, dust puffs, and ズザッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/accordion/README.md)
- [Stepper](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/stepper/stepper.js): `<sakuga-stepper>`: Step navigation that shoots energy lines, shockwave rings, and ポン. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/stepper/README.md)
- [Dialog](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/dialog/dialog.js): `<sakuga-dialog>`: Impact modal dialog that slams down with dust clouds and massive ドン!. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/dialog/README.md)
- [Drawer](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/drawer/drawer.js): `<sakuga-drawer>`: Slide-over sheet that streaks in with speed lines and brakes with シュッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/drawer/README.md)
- [Popconfirm](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/popconfirm/popconfirm.js): `<sakuga-popconfirm>`: Speech-bubble confirmation that springs open and clicks with カチッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/popconfirm/README.md)
- [Badge](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/badge/badge.js): `<sakuga-badge>`: Bounces with ポン on count change and slices with shards when dismissed. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/badge/README.md)
- [Counter](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/counter/counter.js): `<sakuga-counter>`: Combo counter that triggers speed lines, burst, and ドン! on milestones. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/counter/README.md)
- [Card](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/card/card.js): `<sakuga-card>`: Comic panel card with 3D spring tilt, corner speed lines, and click reaction. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/card/README.md)
- [Meter](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/meter/meter.js): `<sakuga-meter>`: Combat power & health gauge; damage flashes impact frame with shards, recharge rumbles with ゴゴゴゴ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/meter/README.md)
- [Segmented](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/segmented/segmented.js): `<sakuga-segmented>`: Dash switcher; indicator streaks with motion smear and brakes with シュッ. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/segmented/README.md)
- [Spinner](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/spinner/spinner.js): `<sakuga-spinner>`: Ki vortex aura spinner that pulses shockwave rings and finishes with impact burst. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/spinner/README.md)
- [Avatar](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/avatar/avatar.js): `<sakuga-avatar>`: Hero avatar that awakens with power wedges, shockwave ring, and ポン. [Docs](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/blob/main/avatar/README.md)

Install any one with the shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add finktheartist/sakuga-vfx/NAME`. The file lands in `public/sakuga-vfx/`.

Colours are --sk-* CSS variables; a page's own :root values win. Effects switch off for prefers-reduced-motion.

## The skill

- [sakuga-vfx skill](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/skills/sakuga-vfx/SKILL.md): the workflow and rules these were made by. Install with `npx skills add finktheartist/sakuga-vfx`.
- [core.js](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/skills/sakuga-vfx/core.js): the shared core.
- [starter.html](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/skills/sakuga-vfx/starter.html): starter like button template.
- [look.mjs](https://sakuga-vfx.vercel.app/skills/sakuga-vfx/look.mjs): frame-by-frame visual audit script.
